moments.title: Champions League Matchday 1 Kicks Off
moments.blurb: The league phase of the 2026/27 UEFA Champions League begins with Matchday 1 fixtures across Europe, including several UK teams in action over three days.

angles.name: Today's action
angles.copy: Champions League is BACK! Aston Villa face Club Brugge and Man City travel to Porto tonight for Matchday 1. Who are you backing?

angles.name: Tomorrow's games
angles.copy: More Champions League tomorrow! Liverpool host Atlético Madrid and Arsenal are away at Napoli. Big tests for the Premier League giants!

angles.name: Man Utd return
angles.copy: Manchester United make their Champions League return on Thursday, taking on Sabah. How far do you think they'll go this season?

moments.title: Strictly Come Dancing Launch Show
moments.blurb: The 24th series of Strictly Come Dancing begins with its highly anticipated launch show on BBC One, introducing new celebrity-professional pairings and new hosts.

angles.name: Launch Day Buzz
angles.copy: Get ready to cha-cha-cha! Strictly Come Dancing returns for its launch show on Saturday 19th September. Who are you excited to see on the dancefloor?

angles.name: New Hosts & Judges
angles.copy: New faces on Strictly! Emma Willis, Josh Widdicombe, and Johannes Radebe join as hosts. What do we think of the new line-up?

moments.title: Great British Bake Off Season 17
moments.blurb: The Great British Bake Off is back for its 17th series on Channel 4, with a fresh batch of bakers and Nigella Lawson joining Paul Hollywood as a new judge.

angles.name: Bake Off is Back
angles.copy: On your marks, get set, BAKE! The Great British Bake Off returns Tuesday 22nd September. Who's excited for soggy bottoms and showstoppers?

angles.name: New Judge Alert
angles.copy: A new face in the tent! Nigella Lawson joins Paul Hollywood as a judge for this series of Bake Off. What do you think she'll bring to the table?

moments.title: Prince Harry's 42nd Birthday
moments.blurb: Prince Harry, Duke of Sussex, celebrates his 42nd birthday on Sunday, September 15th.

angles.name: Royal Birthday
angles.copy: Wishing Prince Harry, Duke of Sussex, a very happy 42nd birthday this Sunday! How do you think he'll be celebrating?

moments.title: Joe Perry (Aerosmith) 76th Birthday
moments.blurb: Aerosmith's legendary guitarist, Joe Perry, turns 76 on Thursday, September 10th.

angles.name: Rock Legend
angles.copy: Happy 76th birthday to the incredible Joe Perry of Aerosmith! What's your favourite guitar riff from him?

moments.title: Don Powell (Slade) 80th Birthday
moments.blurb: Slade's iconic drummer, Don Powell, celebrates his 80th birthday on Thursday, September 10th.

angles.name: Glam Rock Icon
angles.copy: Happy 80th birthday to Don Powell, the legendary drummer of Slade! What's your go-to Slade anthem?

moments.title: Siobhan Fahey (Bananarama) 68th Birthday
moments.blurb: Siobhan Fahey, known for her work with Bananarama and Shakespears Sister, turns 68 on Thursday, September 10th.

angles.name: Pop Star Birthday
angles.copy: Wishing a very happy 68th birthday to Siobhan Fahey! From Bananarama to Shakespears Sister, what's your favourite track?

moments.title: Morten Harket (a-ha) 67th Birthday
moments.blurb: Morten Harket, the distinctive voice of Norwegian synth-pop band a-ha, celebrates his 67th birthday on Monday, September 14th.

angles.name: Take On Me
angles.copy: Happy 67th birthday to Morten Harket from a-ha! Still taking on the charts with his incredible voice. What's your favourite a-ha song?

moments.title: Joanne Catherall (The Human League) 64th Birthday
moments.blurb: Joanne Catherall, vocalist with the iconic synth-pop group The Human League, turns 64 on Friday, September 18th.

angles.name: Don't You Want Me
angles.copy: Happy 64th birthday to Joanne Catherall of The Human League! Still sounds incredible decades later. What's your favourite track?

moments.title: Frankie Avalon 86th Birthday
moments.blurb: American singer and actor Frankie Avalon, known for his 50s and 60s pop hits, celebrates his 86th birthday on Friday, September 18th.

angles.name: Teen Idol
angles.copy: Happy 86th birthday to the original teen idol, Frankie Avalon! 'Venus' is still a classic. What's your favourite Frankie track?

moments.title: Ricky Bell (New Edition, Bell Biv DeVoe) 59th Birthday
moments.blurb: Ricky Bell, member of R&B groups New Edition and Bell Biv DeVoe, turns 59 on Friday, September 18th.

angles.name: R&B Star
angles.copy: Happy 59th birthday to Ricky Bell! From New Edition to Bell Biv DeVoe, he's given us so many R&B classics. Which is your favourite?

moments.title: Autumn Fair at NEC Birmingham Concludes
moments.blurb: The UK's leading trade show for home, gift, garden, and fashion, Autumn Fair, wraps up today at the NEC Birmingham.

angles.name: Last Day for Retailers
angles.copy: It's the final day for Autumn Fair at the NEC Birmingham! Retailers, grab those last-minute trends for home, gift, and fashion.

moments.title: Heritage Open Days Begin
moments.blurb: England's largest festival of history and culture, Heritage Open Days, starts this Friday, offering free access to thousands of historic sites.

angles.name: Explore for Free
angles.copy: Unlock history this weekend! Heritage Open Days kick off on Friday, with thousands of free events across England. Where will you explore?

moments.title: Roald Dahl Day
moments.blurb: Sunday, September 13th marks Roald Dahl Day, celebrating the life and works of the beloved children's author, with events at his museum in Great Missenden.

angles.name: Phizz-Whizzing Day
angles.copy: Happy Roald Dahl Day this Sunday! What's your favourite of his marvellous stories?

moments.title: Abergavenny Food Festival
moments.blurb: The acclaimed Abergavenny Food Festival takes place next weekend in Monmouthshire, South Wales, featuring tastings, chef demos, and workshops.

angles.name: Foodie Fun in Wales
angles.copy: Food lovers, get ready! The Abergavenny Food Festival is next weekend in Monmouthshire. Who's heading to Wales for some delicious delights?

moments.title: Blackpool Illuminations Shine Bright
moments.blurb: The iconic Blackpool Illuminations are now officially underway, lighting up the Lancashire coastline until January 2027.

angles.name: Lights On
angles.copy: Blackpool is glowing! The famous Illuminations are officially on, bringing light and magic to the coast. Have you visited yet?

moments.title: London Design Festival Begins
moments.blurb: The London Design Festival, showcasing contemporary design, architecture, and art, kicks off this Saturday across the capital.

angles.name: Design Capital
angles.copy: London becomes the design capital this weekend as the London Design Festival begins! Expect stunning installations and creative events across the city.
